question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_combos AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
    FROM customers c CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) as month,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as monthly_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ac.customer_id,
           ac.month,
           COALESCE(mn.monthly_change, 0) as monthly_change
    FROM all_combos ac
    LEFT JOIN monthly_net mn ON ac.customer_id = mn.customer_id AND ac.month = mn.month
)
SELECT customer_id,
       month,
       monthly_change,
       SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as closing_balance
FROM combined
ORDER BY customer_id, month
